question: With regard to the effect of gastric emptying on the oral absorption of drugs, which of the following statements is correct ?:

options.opa: The higher the volume of intake, the lower the gastric emptying rate.
options.opb: Liquid products leave the stomach at a slower rate than solids.
options.opc: Lipid intake increases the rate of gastric emptying.
options.opd: By a mechanical mechanism, the left supine decubitus position increases the rate of gastric emptying.
